clips.title: The story
paras: In northeastern Ashenvale, Bough Shadow lies east of Forest Song beneath a colossal Great Tree. Its roots surround an ancient portal into the Emerald Dream.

Bough Shadow gathers beneath a Great Tree whose roots wind around a natural crossing into the Emerald Dream. The Green Dragonflight guards the quiet grove. Emerald drakes such as Phantim and Dreamstalker circle above the canopy, while Emeraldon dragonspawn and oracles patrol the swirling green portal at the tree’s base. Mortals who approach without permission are turned away.
